items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let's see. Do you remember a fellow named David Jones? Yes, he was a Sullivan player. [INTERVIEWEE] It wasn't a Sullivan player, but a mellophone player.

ctx.x: One was the Dodds, the drummer, who was a very good drummer and traveled extensively and better bands. Later on I had a band, a family band. And the bass player is still playing in one of the bands in Chicago now. I don't remember his name. He couldn't read music at that time. But he was a very good bass player anyhow. One of the best colored bands in the business.
Let's see. Do you remember a fellow named David Jones? Yes, he was a Sullivan player.
It wasn't a Sullivan player, but a mellophone player.
